title: Theme editor framework: dial registry, schema 2 manifests and ThemeControls
detail:
Plan steps 1, 2 and 4: dials.json and typed accessors, SiteStyle look keys (register, type, motion, hero, image, centered header, accent) stored sparsely so every existing site reads back identically, manifest schema 2 with schema 1 still valid, and the generic ThemeControls (Simple bar, Advanced sheet, Looks). Services is the first theme on it; converting the other themes (plan step 9) is separate rows.

Dial registry (lib/theme/dials.json + dials.ts), five sparse SiteStyle dials plus accent that read back identically for every existing site, schema 2 manifest support via lib/themes/editor-schema2.json (a theme with no entry stays schema 1 and shows its four dials), and the generic ThemeControls mounted in the editor Theme tab. It draws nothing until a theme declares a dial beyond the four legacy ones, so no live site's editor changed. Kit and the Look a person picked are not stored: the kit applies through the starter-kit flow and the Look is derived from the dial values. The centered header and the floating preview bar are LIVE-1999.
